envelope.description: readDirs on the turn request and the claude flag

body.title: readDirs on the turn request and the claude flag
body.summary: TurnRequest gains optional readDirs. The claude adapter's buildArgs adds `--add-dir` with each directory before the permission flags when readDirs is non-empty. The codex adapter's argv is unchanged (checked with the real CLI: paths in the prompt are enough).
acceptanceChecks: With readDirs the claude argv has --add-dir and each directory before the permission flags, and the prompt is still last after --
Without readDirs the claude argv is byte-identical to today, with and without resume, each mode and allowedTools
The codex argv is the same with and without readDirs

tests.name: claude argv: readDirs adds --add-dir with each directory before the permission flags and the prompt stays last after --; without readDirs the argv is byte-identical to today
codex argv is unchanged by readDirs
